about: The daily schedule: puzzle n (n = days since epoch + 1) plays answer n of its mode's list, wrapping round. Only words marked Keep on the review page. Written by tools/compile_game.py; words gives each 2+ kanji answer's [reading, meanings]. meanings gives each answer's meaning in other languages (MEANING_FILES).
